$comment: Single source of truth for material presets, lighting presets, platforms, appearances and render quality tiers. Read by the web UI (sliders/labels) and the Blender worker (defaults). Param keys are camelCase. 'paint' = the SVG art colour of the layer (texture or fill override) and how each preset consumes it.

liquid_glass.label: Liquid Glass
liquid_glass.description: Thick clear glass with a light art-colour tint and a thin wet coat - real refraction of what is beneath.

paintMode.label: Use Art Colour As
paintMode.help: Where the layer's SVG colours (texture) go: Base Color, Emission Color, or both.

tint.label: Art Colour Amount
tint.help: Mix(white -> art colour) into Base Color. Glass: low = clear, high = coloured glass.

filmVariation.label: Film Variation
filmVariation.help: Noise-driven Thin Film thickness variation (oil-slick bands).

studio.label: Studio
studio.description: Balanced softbox key, grazing rim strips, front fill.

dramatic.label: Dramatic
dramatic.description: Strong key, deep shadows, bright rims.

top.label: Top Light
top.description: Icon Composer 2.0 style vertical light from above.

darkfield.label: Dark Field
darkfield.description: Product-photography glass lighting: black surround, bright edge strips.

macos.label: macOS
macos.note: 824/1024 body with 100 px margin and a baked drop shadow.

android.label: Android
android.note: Adaptive icon: 108dp layers, 72dp safe zone; foreground = layers, background = plate.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: EEVEE, ~0.2 s warm. Live layout + lighting.

preview.label: Preview
preview.description: Cycles OptiX + OptiX denoise, ~1 s. First faithful glass.

brand.label: Brand-exact
brand.description: SVG colours exactly (Standard view transform) plus a highlight soft clip: identity below the knee (linear, per channel); rims and glints roll off smoothly toward white.

liquid-glass.label: Liquid Glass
liquid-glass.description: Apple iOS 26-style glass layers on a satin plate.

candy.label: Candy
candy.description: Glossy hard candy with subsurface glow.

chrome.label: Chrome
chrome.description: Polished chrome glyphs on an anodized plate.

neon.label: Neon
neon.description: Glowing neon tubes on a dark plate.

soft-3d.label: Soft 3D
soft-3d.description: Subtle depth, colour-exact — closest to the original art.

principledSchema.$comment: Every material = ONE Principled BSDF; params map 1:1 to its inputs (+ Paint pre-processing). Presets are just starting values.
